content.thinking: I miscounted the qvel values—it should only have 6 entries, not 7. Since the free joint's angular velocity is expressed in the body frame (which matches the world frame here due to identity orientation), wy corresponds to index 4, giving the corrected vector "1.555 0 0 0 51.83 0".

content.text:
The keyframe's qvel had one value too many. A free joint has 6 velocity entries: 3 linear, then 3 angular. The corrected line is `qvel="1.555 0 0 0 51.83 0"`, which keeps vx = 1.555 m/s and wy = 51.83 rad/s. Nothing else changed.
